target: 國立成功大學成功校區56亭 / Rotate Truss Pavilion
scope: Complete visible pavilion exterior approximation; not whole courtyard, measured reconstruction, 2026 condition or physical print certification. Reviewer changed no geometry.
source_viewing: All fourteen author photos/drawings plus school full view inspected personally in source research. At final review re-opened architect-05 reverse long side, 09 broad high end/stairs, 11 tapered six-column plan. Re-opened all five newly frozen final PNGs after stair revision; no prior-version PNG hashes reused.

view_checks.front: Complete front signed side; brown inverted timber triangles, dark new steel, six columns, open underdeck and revised stair widths descending broader toward ground.
view_checks.rear: Opposite truss and side remain open; same single sign back rather than second readable sign, narrow-end angled connection and taper visible.
view_checks.elevation: One continuous inclined roof, lower folded truss chord, actual triangle web openings, unequal column bays and dark diagonal supports retained.
view_checks.top: Roof and platform taper broad/high to narrow/low; no ridge or invented second roof facet, local end finishes appropriately bounded.
view_checks.left_oblique: Wide high-end portal stays open; four central stair tread surfaces now widen toward lower ground and side offset blocks present, two timber frames and roof grid visible underneath.

accepted_features: Two flipped/rotated salvaged triangular timber trusses with preserved web topology and lower folded chords.
Six ground columns in two rows of three, unequal 365/475 proportional bays; strong diagonals not extra feet.
Single inclined PC sheet in tapered trapezoidal plan, no ordinary double-gable.
Raised tapered deck, underdeck air, separate footings, revised four central stairs and limited low-end angled connector.
One approximate 56亭 sign; back view observes same physical object.
limitations: Designer photographs have no retained capture EXIF; drawings are not certified measured as-builts and cropped unit legend absent. Printed 365/475/100 used as proportions only.
2021 built, 2022-11-11 unveiled; school image EXIF 2023-08-07 12:07:31 without timezone differs from upload 2023-08-09. No 2026 field-survey claim.
Overall millimeters, roughly 22.47-degree roof slope, grid subdivisions, timber joint/bolt dimensions, footing exposure, drain tubes, stair side blocks and sign font are disclosed approximations.
No adjacent building porch, whole courtyard, furniture, trees, loose stepping stones or hidden foundations reconstructed.
PC alpha112 is display material only; STL has no color/transparency and retains a closed thin roof sheet.
Visual-source PASS is not physical print, support-free, structural strength, slicer or exhaustive thickness certification. Preserve documented thin-layer/overhang warnings.
revision_note: Builder corrected central stair width ordering and side offset blocks before this review. Earlier review write was stopped by a hash assertion during the change; no old PASS record was issued.
